name: Naraku no Shiro Ichiyanagi Nagomu, Nidome no Junan
original_name: 奈落の城 一柳和、2度目の受難
source:
After solving the Amagoushi no Yakata case, Ichiyanagi Nagomu receives an invitation from his friend Hiori to go to the Ruroi castle in Europe. The construction is hidden deep in the valley and the only way to enter is through a rope bridge. Nagomu learned of the history of the castle during dinner with the current owner of the castle.

The ancestor of the young nobleman has been studying black magic and satanic rites. He has been trying to summon a demon by offering youths as sacrifices. After numerous failed attempts, he finally managed to call upon a demon to possess his sacrifice. The castle is then built in the valley to keep the possessed youth from escaping. The youth's mother has entered the castle to find her son, but she too disappeared not long afterwards.

According to the rumors, the ghost of the mother is still in search of her son and the youth is still somewhere within the castle.

During the conversation, the castle is blacked out, and in the darkness the occupants can feel the evil in the air.

[edited from [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-43-49-en-70-2izf.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
解决《雨格子之馆》的案件后，一柳和收到朋友日织的邀请，前往欧洲的鲁洛伊城堡。城堡深藏于山谷，只有一座吊桥能够通行。晚餐时，现任城主向和讲述了这座城堡的历史。

年轻贵族的一位祖先曾研究黑魔法与撒旦仪式，企图献祭年轻人以召唤恶魔。无数次失败后，他终于成功召来恶魔，让其附身于祭品。为了防止被附身的年轻人逃走，他在山谷中建造了这座城堡。年轻人的母亲后来进入城堡寻找儿子，却也在不久后失踪。

传言称，那位母亲的幽灵至今仍在寻找儿子，而年轻人也依然藏在城堡某处。

交谈期间，城堡突然断电。黑暗中，所有人都感受到一股邪恶气息正在空气里蔓延。

[据[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-43-49-en-70-2izf.html]Play-Asia[/url]内容编辑]
